title: Company Secretary
description:
**Company Description**

Grrowwide offers the expertise of a highly experienced team in Financial and Accounting Management, Tax and Business Advisory, Secretarial and Compliance Reporting. Grrowwide is committed to becoming a strategic business partner to its clients and helping them efficiently grow their business while taking care of operational management and other ancillary services.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time on-site role located in Borivali for a Company Secretary. The Company Secretary will be responsible for handling compliance reporting, maintaining statutory records, assisting with regulatory filings, coordinating with various departments, and ensuring adherence to legal standards and corporate governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Secretarial practices and Compliance Reporting
* Basic understanding of Financial and Accounting Management
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law, or a related field
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ICS) are a plus
